title: useCharCount Hook
description:
Implement a `useCharCount` hook for text inputs with a character limit. It returns `{ value, onChange, remaining, isOverLimit }`. `remaining` is `max - value.length`. `isOverLimit` is `true` when the user exceeds the limit.

**Example:**
```tsx
const { value, onChange, remaining, isOverLimit } = useCharCount(140);
```
ai_context: Common mistake: clamping the value at max length inside onChange — the hook should allow typing beyond the limit (showing negative remaining) so the UI can display the over-limit state, not silently block input.
